title: Shaping the NVD for the Future: We Need Your Feedback on AI-Enabled Vulnerability Management
summary: For over two decades, the NIST National Vulnerability Database (NVD) has served as the U.S. government repository for standards-based vulnerability management data and as a foundational resource for cybersecurity risk analysis, vulnerability management, compliance automation, and software security. New Opportunities for the NVD via Automation Our cybersecurity landscape is changing dramatically and is being reconfigured by artificial intelligence (AI) in unique, exciting, and yes, sometimes challenging ways. This is creating openings to potentially leverage AI systems to discover and exploit
author: Harold Booth, Jon Boyens
